# Notification channel artwork

These bundled assets identify the corresponding channels. No external image requests are made at runtime. Logos and brand names belong to their respective owners; the app does not claim affiliation.

The exact vendor URLs are recorded in sources.json:

- WeCom: favicon published by work.weixin.qq.com.
- DingTalk: favicon published by www.dingtalk.com.
- Feishu: favicon published by www.feishu.cn.
- ServerChan: favicon linked by sct.ftqq.com.
- Bark: docs/_media/Icon.png from Finb/Bark (MIT); see Bark-LICENSE.

Webhook, SMTP email and in-app notifications use the app's shared generic icons.
